name: Poseidon
source:
"Don't forget you're not alone anymore, I'll have your back if you have mine!"

You're more likely to find Poseidon at the ocean over haunted houses, but this cowardly giant will always come along for the ride so they can protect their friends.

They are kind and loving to everyone, and treat everyone as a friend...but sometimes they struggle to extend that same kindness to themself.

Likes: The ocean, being active, spending time with friends, cooking
Dislikes: Violence, being left behind, ghosts, mushy peas

[From [url=https://glasswing-games.itch.io/home-is-where-the-heart-is]itch.io[/url]]
